description: Αρχείο Μελετών Τεχνικού Προγράμματος Τμήματος Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης Δήμου Θεσσαλονίκης is a dataset listed in data.gov.gr, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Τμήμα Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης. Andmestik sisaldab säästva liikuvuse ja võrgustike direktoraadi teedeehituse ja liiklusmärkide osakonna tehnilisi uuringuid. Coverage: Τμήμα Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης. The portal shows the English title as "Archief van technische programmastudies van de afdeling Wegenbouw en Wegenondertekening van de gemeente Thessaloniki" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Τμήμα Οδοποιίας και Οδικής Σήμανσης. Its keywords include Από μετάπτωση, Οδική σήμανση, repository.data.gov.gr, Οδοποιία, Μελέτες. The listing shows 6 download or service links in 000, ------. The listing shows 2026-02-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-gr.
